parameters.name: RegisterDataset
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to register the result as a PAI dataset. Valid values:
- true: Registers the annotation result as a PAI dataset.
- false: Exports the annotation result directly to an OSS folder without registering it as a dataset.

parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: Job ID. For information about how to obtain a job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain a tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).
